description: This file defines the declaration of the DeviceIdentification class within the WPEFramework plugin system, including its interface, nested Notification class, and associated methods for device identification functionalities.

classes.name: DeviceIdentification
classes.description: Main class implementing device identification plugin, handling initialization, deinitialization, information retrieval, and device ID functions, with a nested Notification class for remote connection notifications.

classes.name: DeviceIdentification::Notification
classes.description: Nested class implementing remote connection notification handling, invoked on remote connection activation and deactivation events.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the given service, setting up necessary resources.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources when the plugin is being shut down.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns a string with plugin information.

methods.name: get_deviceidentification
methods.description: Retrieves device identification data into the response structure.

methods.name: GetDeviceId
methods.description: Returns the device ID as a string.
